articles.summary: Key Points: Expanded role consolidates oversight of loanDepot’s legal, compliance, corporate governance and enterprise risk management functions Grassi brings more than 35 years of experience in consumer lending law, mortgage regulation, compliance and risk oversight Promotion reflects loanDepot’s continued focus on strengthening governance, regulatory engagement, loan quality and risk management loanDepot, Inc. (NYSE: LDI) (together with its subsidiaries, “loanDepot”), a national retail lender with $584B funded directly to consumers since inception, today announced that Chief Risk Officer Joseph Grassi has been promoted to Chief Legal and Risk Officer. As Chief Legal and Risk Officer, Grassi leads loanDepot’s legal strategy, corporate governance and legal affairs, as well as the Company’s regulatory compliance, loan quality and enterprise risk management functions. He reports directly to loanDepot Founder and CEO Anthony Hsieh. “Joe has been an exceptional leader for loanDepot,” said
articles.title: loanDepot Promotes Joseph Grassi to Chief Legal and Risk Officer
